secondary: persistence_2: primary, alert only on 2 consecutive 30 s rows in alert
protocol.current_model: trained on every campaign healthy row (12-13 Nov), per region
protocol.retrained_model: campaign healthy rows + live rows from live start to held_out_start - embargo
protocol.false_alarms: alert onsets on held-out live rows outside every exclusion window; Poisson 95% CI
protocol.detection: 20 campaign trials, campaign_ml blocked 5-fold split; the retrained model adds the live training rows to every fold's training set
protocol.exclusions: every SSM command in either region during the run (read-only list-commands), plus incidents the operator reports, fixed before the retrain is scored
protocol.decision: report both models side by side; no threshold or feature is tuned on live data
protocol.witness_gap_rule: a row is dropped (train and held-out) when the HTTP witness log has no record in the 60 s up to the row; reported as a row count
